description: Drishti SAT UHF transceiver (OpenLST-based, CC1110, 437 MHz). ESP UART framing: 0x22 0x69 | len(1) | payload; payload = hwid(2 LE) + seqnum(2 LE) + system(1) + command(1) + data. Max payload 251 B (frame 254 B). All fields little-endian. Firmware v6.1.3.

nodes.name: UHF
nodes.description: UHF transceiver (hwid-addressed; GS uses HWID_LOCAL 0xFFFF which the radio always accepts)

enums.name: PaPower
enums.doc_reference: board_defaults.h RF_PA_CONFIG0..8 (CC1110 PA_TABLE codes with measured output power)

messages.name: PING
messages.description: Ping — the radio echoes an ACK (common_msg_ack).

messages.name: REBOOT_POSTPONE
messages.description: Schedule/postpone the auto-reboot to now + postpone seconds (max 604800).

parameters.name: Postpone
parameters.description: Seconds until reboot (0 = next schedule tick)

messages.name: GET_TIME
messages.description: Read the radio RTC; NACK if time was never set. Reply: TIME.

messages.name: GET_TELEM
messages.description: Read the full telemetry block. Reply: TELEM.

messages.name: GET_CALLSIGN
messages.description: Read the station callsign. Reply: CALLSIGN.

messages.name: SEND_TELEM
messages.description: Beacon trigger: transmit the telemetry beacon over RF. NO UART reply.
